suppress.notes: False positive - CVE targets native ICU C/C++ library, not Java icu4j
False positive - CVE targets native ICU library, not Java icu4j
False positive - CVE-2025-68161 affects log4j-core SslSocketManager, not log4j-api. This project uses logback via SLF4J and does not include log4j-core.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-42582 is in QpackDecoder of netty-codec-http3 (HTTP/3), a 4.2.x-only module fixed in 4.2.13.Final. This project uses netty 4.1.x (HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 only) and does not depend on netty-codec-http3, so the vulnerable code path is not on the classpath.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-47835 affects only the Elasticsearch, OpenSearch and GemFire vector stores (spring-ai-elasticsearch-store / -opensearch-store / -gemfire-store). This project uses the OpenAI model starter only and includes none of those vector store modules.
Not applicable - CVE-2026-41863 is a path traversal in Spring AI's support for Anthropic's Skills API. This project uses the OpenAI model only and does not use the Anthropic Skills API.

Risk accepted (build-time only) - CVE-2026-53914 is code execution via unsafe deserialization of Kotlin build cache metadata, fixed in Kotlin 2.4.20. The affected artifacts are compiler/build tooling on the build classpath, not shipped in the runtime bootJar. Exploitation requires an attacker-controlled build cache; this project uses no shared/remote untrusted build cache. The Kotlin 2.4.x toolchain upgrade is tracked as a separate change. Revisit once that lands.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-54399 is a DoS in the HTTP/1.1 message parser of Apache HttpComponents Core 5 (httpcore5), affecting 5.4.2 and earlier; the fix (finite header line length / count defaults) landed in httpcore5 5.4.3. This project ships httpcore 4.4.16 - the terminal 4.x release, pulled in transitively by the AWS SDK apache-client - which does not contain the vulnerable 5.x parser. Dependency-check matches it by CPE only; no 4.x fix exists because the 4.x line is not affected.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-54428 is a DoS in the HTTP/2 HPACK decoder of the httpcore5-h2 module (Apache HttpComponents Core 5). This project ships httpcore 4.4.16, the terminal 4.x release pulled in transitively by the AWS SDK apache-client; the 4.x line has no HTTP/2 / HPACK support and none of the vulnerable code is on the classpath. Dependency-check matches it by CPE only; no 4.x fix exists because the 4.x line is not affected.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-66299 is uncontrolled resource consumption in the WebSocket chat example of Tomcat's "examples" web application. Spring Boot's embedded Tomcat never ships it: the embed jars contain no classes matching example or websocket/chat, so the vulnerable code is not on the classpath. Dependency-check matches by CPE against the Tomcat product version only. Fixed upstream in 10.1.59 (10.1.58 RC failed vote); bumped in this project accordingly.

False positive - CVE-2026-54285 is a DoS in the JavaScript @opentelemetry/core npm package (unbounded memory in W3C Baggage propagation, fixed in npm 2.8.0). This project uses the Java opentelemetry-api/opentelemetry-context jars; dependency-check matches by CPE only. The Java packages are not affected and there is no Java fix to apply.
Not applicable - CVE-2026-47884 is an SSRF/RCE in Spring MVC XsltView. This project uses Thymeleaf for view rendering and does not configure XsltView anywhere.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-47885 is a maxPartSize bypass in WebFlux's PartEventHttpMessageReader. This project uses Spring MVC (spring-boot-starter-web), not Spring WebFlux; the vulnerable reader is never invoked.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-47886 is a DoS triggered when evaluating user-supplied SpEL expressions containing the power operator (^) with BigDecimal/BigInteger. This project does not expose any endpoint or code path that evaluates user-supplied SpEL.
Not applicable - CVE-2026-47888 is a memory leak via a malformed RSocket SETUP frame in Spring RSocket. This project does not use RSocket; no RSocket handler is configured.
Not applicable - CVE-2026-47889 is a sameSite attribute loss in the Jetty 12 Core reactive adapter. This project uses Spring Boot's default embedded Tomcat server, not Jetty.
Not applicable - CVE-2026-47890 is a CRLF injection in Spring MVC/WebFlux Server-Sent Events (SSE) fragment rendering. This project is a REST API and does not expose any SSE endpoints.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-47892 is a header predicate bypass in WebFlux functional endpoints deployed with DispatcherServlet. This project uses Spring MVC with annotation-based controllers, not WebFlux functional endpoints.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-47893 is a request-header exposure in WebFlux WebSocket handshake exception messages (HandshakeWebsocketService). This project uses Spring MVC and does not use Spring WebFlux WebSocket support.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-59282 is a DoS via user-supplied property paths in Spring's DataBinder infrastructure. This project binds all request data through Jackson JSON deserialization (@RequestBody) and does not use DataBinder with user-supplied property paths.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-59283 is a SpEL safety-guard bypass when SimpleEvaluationContext is used with the SpEL compiler and user-supplied expressions. This project does not evaluate user-supplied SpEL expressions.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-59313 is content spoofing in the Spring MVC functional web framework SSE support. This project does not use SSE endpoints and uses only annotation-based Spring MVC controllers (not the functional web DSL).

Not applicable - CVE-2026-59270 affects Spring Security's embedded UnboundID LDAP server (UnboundIdContainer), which exposes its admin bind DN on all interfaces. This project authenticates via OAuth2/OIDC with Authentik and does not configure an embedded LDAP server.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-41707 is a DPoP proof replay attack in DPoPProofJwtDecoderFactory (spring-security-oauth2-resource-server). This project uses standard Bearer token OAuth2 and does not configure DPoP-bound access tokens.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-47841 is a WebAuthn authentication bypass where a UserVerificationRequirement restored from a serialized session is silently downgraded. This project does not use WebAuthn; authentication is handled entirely via OAuth2/OIDC.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-59318 is a tool-calling privilege escalation in Spring AI's DefaultToolCallingManager. This project uses ChatClient for simple prompt/response text generation only (system + user prompt) and does not configure or invoke any tools.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-47851 is an OOM/unbounded recursion in Spring AI's PDF Document Reader. This project uses the OpenAI model starter only and does not include the spring-ai-pdf-document-reader module; the vulnerable class is not on the classpath.

Not applicable - CVE-2026-47852 is a predictable ONNX model cache directory vulnerability in Spring AI's ONNX transformer support. This project does not use ONNX-based embedding models; no spring-ai-onnx-transformers module is on the classpath.
